LanguageData.CC_GodGift_Ask_Text: {PAWN} would like to give {WHAT} from the stores to {GOD}, at {PLACE}. {WHY} {HOPE}\n\nThe colony has {HELD} of it in its stores and would keep {LEFT}. {PAWN} won't take any of it without the colony's leave.
LanguageData.CC_GodGift_Ask_Why: {PAWN} says the everyday gifts are only what the colony can spare, and that {GOD} should now and then have something the colony values.
LanguageData.CC_GodGift_Ask_Dream: {PAWN} dreamt that {GOD} asked for this, and wants to give it while the dream is still fresh.
LanguageData.CC_GodGift_Ask_HopeAny: {PAWN} hopes {GOD} will look kindly on the colony.
LanguageData.CC_GodGift_Ask_NoLonger: The colony no longer has that much {THING}.
LanguageData.CC_GodGift_NotCarried: {PAWN} could not carry the {THING} to {PLACE}, and it stays in the stores.
LanguageData.CC_GodGift_ReturnFound: {PAWN} found {WHAT} at {PLACE}, where the offering had lain.
LanguageData.CC_GodGift_ReturnLeft: {WHAT} lies at {PLACE}, where the offering had lain.
LanguageData.CC_GodGift_From: from the gifts the colony left it
LanguageData.CC_GodGift_LineAsked: {WHAT}, given by {BY} at {PLACE} with the colony's leave.
LanguageData.CC_GodGift_Fate_Unseen: It was gone, and nobody saw it go.
LanguageData.CC_GodGift_Fate_Plain: It was taken before the eyes of {WHO}.
LanguageData.CC_GodGift_Fate_PlainNobody: It was taken in plain sight.
LanguageData.CC_GodGift_Fate_Given: It was given to a visitor to carry on.
LanguageData.CC_GodGift_Fate_Animal: An animal ate it where it lay.
LanguageData.CC_GodGift_Fate_Returned: It was still there, and went back to the stores.
LanguageData.CC_GodTemper_Band_2: {NAME} has given no sign that it marks us
